summary: Short, very steep kerb with houses and apartments within 12-20 m.
reasons: Houses 12 m away on same side

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12 m (houses) and 20 m (apartments) from the kerb, all on this side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars park on the west side, east kerb is narrow with trees.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street, but the stretch is too short and steep.

sun_shade: Tree canopy over the kerb; apartment block shades from the east.

best_section.where: Foxton Street east kerb, by the Hillside apartments
